That's the worst version of tired — the kind where sleep is right there and your brain won't let you have it. So you're stuck in the hallway between wanting to shut down and needing to get something out, and neither one gets to happen.

If lying down just means lying there with it, then the "say something" part is probably the one that actually needs air first. Not the whole thing — just enough that your head has somewhere to put it down.

What's the thing you'd be thinking about in the dark?
